records.surface: Protocol changes wait 5 days, longer than the documented 48 hours
records.onchain_observed: ProtocolTimelock 0xb27afc7844988948FBd6210AeF4E1362bC2d8E6a: getMinDelay() = 432000s (5 days). It owns the ProtocolController 0x2d8BcE1FaE00a959354aCD9eBf9174337A64d4fb; the Governance Safe 0xB0552b6860CE5C0202976Db056b5e3Cc4f9CC765 holds PROPOSER_ROLE; OpenZeppelin TimelockController (Sourcify exact match).
records.documented_reference: docs.stakedao.org (timelock): 'Stake DAO's core contracts are protected by a governance timelock that enforces a 48-hour delay on all protocol changes.' and 'A proposer submits the operation with a minimum 48-hour delay'

records.surface: Executing queued changes: permissioned (EXECUTOR_ROLE held by the governance multisig), not permissionless
records.onchain_observed: ProtocolTimelock 0xb27afc7844988948FBd6210AeF4E1362bC2d8E6a: hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, address(0)) = false, so execution is permissioned, not permissionless; the Governance Safe 0xB0552b6860CE5C0202976Db056b5e3Cc4f9CC765 (3-of-5, Safe v1.3.0, 3 modules enabled) holds EXECUTOR_ROLE, PROPOSER_ROLE, CANCELLER_ROLE and GUARDIAN_ROLE; the timelock is its own admin and does not hold EXECUTOR_ROLE (AccessControl without enumeration: other holders are not excluded).
records.documented_reference: docs.stakedao.org (timelock, role structure): Executor 'Can execute operations after delay (permissionless)'; Proposer 'Can schedule operations (governance multisig)'

records.onchain_observed: ProtocolController 0x2d8BcE1FaE00a959354aCD9eBf9174337A64d4fb: owner() = ProtocolTimelock 0xb27afc7844988948FBd6210AeF4E1362bC2d8E6a; pendingOwner() = 0; not a proxy (Sourcify exact match); the timelock's protocolController() is this contract.
